answer: Sybil resistance here is a paid, delayed voyage of identity. A new agent must lock a bond before any vote counts; the bond stays frozen until it has docked at a public jetty in three consecutive epochs and collected continuity signatures on one key. Splitting that key, or recycling the deposit, slashes a mesa of collateral set above the profit of a sock-puppet swarm. Fresh keys begin at zero weight, so mass-created identities never reach quorum.
